newsitem.title: UK: British economy grows 0.8 pct in fourth quarter.
newsitem.headline: British economy grows 0.8 pct in fourth quarter.

text.p: Britain's economy grew 0.8 percent in the fourth quarter for annual growth of 2.6 percent in 1996, official figures showed on Monday.
The figures, which were in line with analysts' expectations, could have a key role in official discussions on whether to raise interest rates before the imminent election.
Finance minister Kenneth Clarke said the data showed the British economy had gone from "strength to strength" in 1996.
Government bonds drifted back after the data but there was little market reaction.
Analysts said the growth figures did not increase the pressure for an interest rate rise but they added that the fourth quarter figure could be revised upward in coming months.
